## Distributed Systems Notation {#sec-notation-distributed}

Distributed-systems work introduces a second layer of notation for coordination, communication, and reliability. Some symbols below are reserved for synchronization, repair, and gradient-sizing contexts; defining them centrally keeps the canonical form unambiguous when they appear. Every symbol here extends the series core without redefining it. Where a field model keeps its literature's letters, the table names the core concept each letter stands for. Under ideal partitioning of fixed work, the central equation is the **Fleet Law** (the distributed step time law, @eq-fleet-law):

$$\DistributedStepTime = \frac{\IronlawTermTimesCompute}{N} + \CommunicationTime + \SynchronizationTime - \OverlappedTime$$

| **Symbol**                   | **Definition**                                      | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|:-----------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------|:--------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$T_{\text{write}}$**       | **Checkpoint write time**                           | seconds       | Time to persist model state to storage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{decode}}$**      | **Codec Decode Time**                               | seconds       | Local decompression overhead after transfer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **$T_{\text{encode}}$**      | **Codec Encode Time**                               | seconds       | Local compression overhead before transfer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **$T_{\text{comm}}(N)$**     | **Communication Time**                              | seconds       | Wall-clock time to transmit a message of size $n$ across one link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$\rho$**                   | **Communication-Computation Ratio**                 | Dimensionless | $\rho = T_{\text{comm}}(N)/(T_{\text{compute}}/N)$. Values near or above 1 indicate communication-bound scaling.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **$T_{\text{compressed}}$**  | **Compressed Communication Time**                   | seconds       | Total time after encode, transfer of $M/r_{\text{comp}}$, and decode.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **$n^*$**                    | **Crossover Point**                                 | bytes         | $n^* = \alpha \cdot \beta$. Below $n^*$: latency-bound. Above: bandwidth-bound.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_{\text{step}}(N)$**     | **Distributed Step Time**                           | seconds       | Wall-clock time for one training step at scale $N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **$R_{\text{eff}}$**         | **Effective Fleet Throughput**                      | FLOP/s        | $R_{\text{eff}} = (N R_{\text{peak}}) \times \text{MFU} \times \eta_{\text{scaling}} \times \eta_{\text{goodput}}$, where $\text{MFU}$ is the single-device baseline, $\eta_{\text{scaling}}$ captures all in-step scaling loss, and $\eta_{\text{goodput}}$ captures only out-of-step operational loss excluded from $T_N$. |
| **$\eta_{\text{goodput}}$**  | **Goodput Ratio**                                   | Dimensionless | Fraction of allocated wall time remaining after the out-of-step losses in $f_{\text{overhead}}$; often $\eta_{\text{goodput}} = 1 - f_{\text{overhead}}$.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **$p$**                      | **Hidden dimension; time; distribution $p(\cdot)$** | Integer       | Number of physical pipeline stages in model-depth partitioning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$M_{\text{KV}}$**          | **KV-Cache Memory**                                 | bytes         | Key-value cache footprint for autoregressive serving.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **$\beta$**                  | **Link Bandwidth**                                  | bytes/s       | Effective throughput per link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$T_{\text{long}}(n)$**     | **LogGP Long-Message Time**                         | seconds       | Transfer time for an $n$-byte long message. Reuses $n$ from the $\alpha$-$\beta$ model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$\text{MTBF}$**            | **Mean Time Between Failures**                      | hours         | Average time between consecutive failures. $\text{MTBF}_{\text{system}} = \text{MTBF}_{\text{component}} / N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$\text{MTTF}$**            | **Mean Time To Failure**                            | hours         | Component lifetime metric derived from FIT rates. Distinct from system-level $\text{MTBF}$ when repair/replacement cycles are modeled.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$\text{MTTR}$**            | **Mean Time To Repair**                             | hours         | Average recovery time after a failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$T_N$**                    | **N-Device Time**                                   | seconds       | Wall-clock time for the same productive work on $N$ devices; excludes operational downtime counted by $\eta_{\text{goodput}}$.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$f_{\text{overhead}}$**    | **Operational Overhead Fraction**                   | Dimensionless | Fraction of allocated wall time lost outside the productive steps measured by $T_N$, such as checkpoint pauses, failure recovery, scheduler preemption, or maintenance.                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$T^\ast_{\text{ckpt}}$**   | **Optimal Checkpoint Interval**                     | seconds       | Young-Daly formula. Minimizes total wasted time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **$T_{\text{overlap}}$**     | **Overlapped Time**                                 | seconds       | Communication hidden behind computation. Reduces effective overhead.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$\lambda$**                | **Per-Component Failure Rate**                      | failures/hour | Per-component failure rate; the system-wide rate is $N\lambda$ under independent, identical components. The industry-standard reporting unit is FIT (failures per $10^9$ device-hours): $\lambda_{\text{hour}} = \text{FIT} \times 10^{-9}$. *(Not sensitivity—context disambiguates.)*                                      |
| **$b_{\text{pipe}}$**        | **Pipeline Bubble Fraction**                        | Dimensionless | Fraction of pipeline GPU-time spent idle; avoids bare $b$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **$o_{\text{recv}}$**        | **Receiver Overhead**                               | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to complete a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$R_{\text{system}}(t)$**   | **Reliability Function**                            | Probability   | Probability of no failure across the whole system before time $t$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$\eta_{\text{scaling}}$**  | **Scaling Efficiency**                              | Dimensionless | Ratio of measured speedup to ideal linear speedup. $1.0$ is the ideal linear baseline, not a hard upper bound.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$o_{\text{send}}$**        | **Sender Overhead**                                 | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to initiate a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$T_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Single-Device Compute Time**                      | seconds       | The core's compute term, forward + backward pass on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_1$**                    | **Single-Device Time**                              | seconds       | Baseline wall-clock time for the same productive work on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$T_{\text{sync}}(N)$**     | **Synchronization Time**                            | seconds       | Total nonoverlapped synchronization or coordination cost per step at scale $N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_{\text{transfer}}(x)$** | **Transfer Time for Payload $x$**                   | seconds       | Communication time for an $x$-byte payload under the relevant link or collective model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$f_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Useful Compute-Time Fraction**                    | Dimensionless | $(T_{\text{compute}}/N)/T_{\text{step}}(N)$. Measures how much step time is useful local arithmetic after distribution.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$V$**                      | **Virtual Pipeline Stages per Device**              | Integer       | Number of interleaved virtual chunks assigned to each physical pipeline stage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Scaling laws {#sec-notation-scaling-laws}

Scaling laws anchor the book's account of why machine learning moved onto fleets. The single-resource power law and the dense-transformer compute rule are:

$$\mathcal{L}(X) = \ScaleCoefficient X^{-\ScalingExponentScale} + \IrreducibleLoss, \qquad \TrainingCompute \approx 6PD$$

### The \texorpdfstring{$\alpha$-$\beta$}{alpha-beta} communication model {#sec-notation-alpha-beta}

Network communication time decomposes into a fixed latency and a bandwidth-dependent transfer:

$$T(n) = \alpha + \frac{n}{\beta}$$

The model keeps its literature's letters as aliases of core concepts: $\alpha$ is the per-message $\Latency$ and $\beta$ is a link's $\Bandwidth$, written in $\alpha$-$\beta$ form. Inside $\alpha$-$\beta$ formulas, write $\alpha$ and $\beta$; elsewhere, write $\Latency$ and a subscripted $\Bandwidth$.

### The LogGP extension {#sec-notation-loggp}

LogGP refines the $\alpha$-$\beta$ model by separating network latency, processor overhead, and long-message injection gaps. The standard names are short, but the book uses descriptive subscripts for the highest-collision terms. The bare letters $g$ and $G$ keep their LogGP meanings inside this model only.

### Fault tolerance and reliability {#sec-notation-reliability}

System reliability degrades with scale. Assuming independent components with exponential failure distributions, the system reliability across $N$ components is:

$$\ReliabilityFunctionSystem = e^{-N\lambda t}$$

The aggregate exponent uses the system-level rate $N\lambda$, where $\lambda$ is the per-component failure rate under the independent, identical-component assumption. The exponent $N\lambda t$ is dimensionless, so the elapsed time $t$ must use the same time unit as $\lambda$ (hours, when $\lambda$ comes from FIT-derived rates below).

The optimal checkpoint interval balances I/O cost against rework cost:

$$\OptimalCheckpointIntervalCkpt = \sqrt{2 \cdot \CheckpointWriteTime \cdot \MeanTimeBetweenFailures_{\text{system}}}$$

The formula uses *system-wide* mean time between failures (MTBF) (the failure interval for the whole job), not a *component* lifetime; substituting the per-component value would overestimate $\OptimalCheckpointIntervalCkpt$ by $\sqrt{N}$. For dimensional consistency, $\CheckpointWriteTime$ and $\MeanTimeBetweenFailures_{\text{system}}$ must be in the same time units. Industry-standard $\MeanTimeBetweenFailures$ is reported in hours; to combine it with seconds-scale write times, multiply the hour value by 3600. The result $\OptimalCheckpointIntervalCkpt$ then carries the same time unit chosen for the inputs.

| **$\text{MTTF}$**            | **Mean Time To Failure**                            | hours         | Component lifetime metric derived from FIT rates. Distinct from system-level $\text{MTBF}$ when repair/replacement cycles are modeled.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$\text{MTTR}$**            | **Mean Time To Repair**                             | hours         | Average recovery time after a failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| **$f_{\text{overhead}}$**    | **Operational Overhead Fraction**                   | Dimensionless | Fraction of allocated wall time lost outside the productive steps measured by $T_N$, such as checkpoint pauses, failure recovery, scheduler preemption, or maintenance.                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$T^\ast_{\text{ckpt}}$**   | **Optimal Checkpoint Interval**                     | seconds       | Young-Daly formula. Minimizes total wasted time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **$T_{\text{overlap}}$**     | **Overlapped Time**                                 | seconds       | Communication hidden behind computation. Reduces effective overhead.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$\lambda$**                | **Per-Component Failure Rate**                      | failures/hour | Per-component failure rate; the system-wide rate is $N\lambda$ under independent, identical components. The industry-standard reporting unit is FIT (failures per $10^9$ device-hours): $\lambda_{\text{hour}} = \text{FIT} \times 10^{-9}$. *(Not sensitivity—context disambiguates.)*                                      |
| **$b_{\text{pipe}}$**        | **Pipeline Bubble Fraction**                        | Dimensionless | Fraction of pipeline GPU-time spent idle; avoids bare $b$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **$o_{\text{recv}}$**        | **Receiver Overhead**                               | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to complete a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$R_{\text{system}}(t)$**   | **Reliability Function**                            | Probability   | Probability of no failure across the whole system before time $t$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$\eta_{\text{scaling}}$**  | **Scaling Efficiency**                              | Dimensionless | Ratio of measured speedup to ideal linear speedup. $1.0$ is the ideal linear baseline, not a hard upper bound.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$o_{\text{send}}$**        | **Sender Overhead**                                 | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to initiate a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$T_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Single-Device Compute Time**                      | seconds       | The core's compute term, forward + backward pass on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_1$**                    | **Single-Device Time**                              | seconds       | Baseline wall-clock time for the same productive work on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$T_{\text{sync}}(N)$**     | **Synchronization Time**                            | seconds       | Total nonoverlapped synchronization or coordination cost per step at scale $N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_{\text{transfer}}(x)$** | **Transfer Time for Payload $x$**                   | seconds       | Communication time for an $x$-byte payload under the relevant link or collective model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### Compression economics {#sec-notation-compression-economics}

Compression models compare codec overhead against the communication time saved by reducing the payload.

| **Symbol**                   | **Definition**                                      | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|:-----------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------|:--------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$T_{\text{write}}$**       | **Checkpoint write time**                           | seconds       | Time to persist model state to storage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{decode}}$**      | **Codec Decode Time**                               | seconds       | Local decompression overhead after transfer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **$T_{\text{encode}}$**      | **Codec Encode Time**                               | seconds       | Local compression overhead before transfer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **$T_{\text{comm}}(N)$**     | **Communication Time**                              | seconds       | Wall-clock time to transmit a message of size $n$ across one link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$\rho$**                   | **Communication-Computation Ratio**                 | Dimensionless | $\rho = T_{\text{comm}}(N)/(T_{\text{compute}}/N)$. Values near or above 1 indicate communication-bound scaling.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **$T_{\text{compressed}}$**  | **Compressed Communication Time**                   | seconds       | Total time after encode, transfer of $M/r_{\text{comp}}$, and decode.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **$n^*$**                    | **Crossover Point**                                 | bytes         | $n^* = \alpha \cdot \beta$. Below $n^*$: latency-bound. Above: bandwidth-bound.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_{\text{step}}(N)$**     | **Distributed Step Time**                           | seconds       | Wall-clock time for one training step at scale $N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **$R_{\text{eff}}$**         | **Effective Fleet Throughput**                      | FLOP/s        | $R_{\text{eff}} = (N R_{\text{peak}}) \times \text{MFU} \times \eta_{\text{scaling}} \times \eta_{\text{goodput}}$, where $\text{MFU}$ is the single-device baseline, $\eta_{\text{scaling}}$ captures all in-step scaling loss, and $\eta_{\text{goodput}}$ captures only out-of-step operational loss excluded from $T_N$. |

Distinct from system-level $\text{MTBF}$ when repair/replacement cycles are modeled.                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| **$p$**                      | **Hidden dimension; time; distribution $p(\cdot)$** | Integer       | Number of physical pipeline stages in model-depth partitioning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$M_{\text{KV}}$**          | **KV-Cache Memory**                                 | bytes         | Key-value cache footprint for autoregressive serving.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **$\beta$**                  | **Link Bandwidth**                                  | bytes/s       | Effective throughput per link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$T_{\text{long}}(n)$**     | **LogGP Long-Message Time**                         | seconds       | Transfer time for an $n$-byte long message. Reuses $n$ from the $\alpha$-$\beta$ model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$\text{MTBF}$**            | **Mean Time Between Failures**                      | hours         | Average time between consecutive failures. $\text{MTBF}_{\text{system}} = \text{MTBF}_{\text{component}} / N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$\text{MTTF}$**            | **Mean Time To Failure**                            | hours         | Component lifetime metric derived from FIT rates. Distinct from system-level $\text{MTBF}$ when repair/replacement cycles are modeled.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$\text{MTTR}$**            | **Mean Time To Repair**                             | hours         | Average recovery time after a failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$T_N$**                    | **N-Device Time**                                   | seconds       | Wall-clock time for the same productive work on $N$ devices; excludes operational downtime counted by $\eta_{\text{goodput}}$.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$f_{\text{overhead}}$**    | **Operational Overhead Fraction**                   | Dimensionless | Fraction of allocated wall time lost outside the productive steps measured by $T_N$, such as checkpoint pauses, failure recovery, scheduler preemption, or maintenance.                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$T^\ast_{\text{ckpt}}$**   | **Optimal Checkpoint Interval**                     | seconds       | Young-Daly formula. Minimizes total wasted time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **$T_{\text{overlap}}$**     | **Overlapped Time**                                 | seconds       | Communication hidden behind computation. Reduces effective overhead.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$\lambda$**                | **Per-Component Failure Rate**                      | failures/hour | Per-component failure rate; the system-wide rate is $N\lambda$ under independent, identical components. The industry-standard reporting unit is FIT (failures per $10^9$ device-hours): $\lambda_{\text{hour}} = \text{FIT} \times 10^{-9}$. *(Not sensitivity—context disambiguates.)*                                      |
| **$b_{\text{pipe}}$**        | **Pipeline Bubble Fraction**                        | Dimensionless | Fraction of pipeline GPU-time spent idle; avoids bare $b$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **$o_{\text{recv}}$**        | **Receiver Overhead**                               | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to complete a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$R_{\text{system}}(t)$**   | **Reliability Function**                            | Probability   | Probability of no failure across the whole system before time $t$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$\eta_{\text{scaling}}$**  | **Scaling Efficiency**                              | Dimensionless | Ratio of measured speedup to ideal linear speedup. $1.0$ is the ideal linear baseline, not a hard upper bound.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$o_{\text{send}}$**        | **Sender Overhead**                                 | seconds       | Processor/NIC overhead to initiate a message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **$T_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Single-Device Compute Time**                      | seconds       | The core's compute term, forward + backward pass on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_1$**                    | **Single-Device Time**                              | seconds       | Baseline wall-clock time for the same productive work on one device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$T_{\text{sync}}(N)$**     | **Synchronization Time**                            | seconds       | Total nonoverlapped synchronization or coordination cost per step at scale $N$.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$T_{\text{transfer}}(x)$** | **Transfer Time for Payload $x$**                   | seconds       | Communication time for an $x$-byte payload under the relevant link or collective model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$f_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Useful Compute-Time Fraction**                    | Dimensionless | $(T_{\text{compute}}/N)/T_{\text{step}}(N)$. Measures how much step time is useful local arithmetic after distribution.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$V$**                      | **Virtual Pipeline Stages per Device**              | Integer       | Number of interleaved virtual chunks assigned to each physical pipeline stage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Additional units {#sec-notation-distributed-units}

*   **Device nameplates**: This book retains vendor capacity labels such as "80 GB" when naming a device. These labels may denote binary capacity; memory arithmetic converts the registry quantity to decimal bytes before combining it with model or cache footprints. @Sec-appdx-fleet-system-assumptions states this exception to the general decimal-prefix convention.
*   **Network throughput**: Reported in both bytes/s (GB/s, TB/s) and bits/s (Gbps) depending on convention. InfiniBand and Ethernet specifications use Gbps; application-level throughput uses GB/s. We note the convention on first use.
*   **Power in sustainability contexts**: Physical power may use explicitly subscripted $P_{\text{...}}$ variables (for example, $P_{\text{IT}}$, $P_{\text{dynamic}}$, $P_{\text{avg}}$) when the surrounding section is about power or energy. Bare $P$ remains reserved for parameter count.
